author: Kevin Stratvert
description:
In this video, you'll see how to build and deploy a working AI agent using Claude Code and UiPath Coding Agents — where you describe what you want in plain English, Claude Code writes the agent using UiPath's patterns, and UiPath handles the deployment and orchestration. ✨ Get started with UiPath for free: https://www.uipath.com/product/free-trials-and-downloads

You'll learn how to:
• Install Claude Code and UiPath's CLI and connect them so Claude knows UiPath's patterns before it writes a single line
• Describe your agent's behavior in plain language and let Claude Code build it for you
• Watch Claude Code catch and fix its own mistakes in real time — no manual debugging
• Test your agent locally by sending it a support ticket and reading the response
• Push your finished agent to UiPath's platform with one command
